text:
maria-ux: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp is still creating duplicate orders when the token refresh + retry hits during POST /orders. Customer hit this in a live demo today.
shawn-devex: Oof. Is that the same replay-on-401 thing we've seen or something different? Any request IDs or logs?
maria-ux: Looks like: client gets 401, refreshes token, retries the exact POST, server accepted the first one. We don't set any idempotency key in the sampleapp by default.
natalie-sdk: We currently document X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key but SDKs don't auto-generate it. We could add an opt-in safe-replay mode to auto-set the header for mutating calls.
alex-ops: For customer demos I'd rather not change server behavior. Can the sampleapp set the header on the client side? That would be the lowest-risk fix.
maria-ux: Users expect the demo to "just work" — asking for UX: default idempotency in dev mode seems reasonable. Proposal: SDK generates an idempotency key for single-request mutating calls in dev/sampleapps unless disabled.
shawn-devex: Two concerns: 1) streaming / long-polling requests shouldn't get implicit keys, 2) parity across Node/Go/Python so docs don't diverge.
natalie-sdk: Agreed. Proposed config: REDWOOD_SDK_SAFE_REPLAY=off|dev|always. Default: dev for sampleapps and local runs, off in production builds. Also add header X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key: <uuid> when enabled.
maria-ux: Also the sampleapp retry logic uses a fixed 100ms retry delay — that's causing tight duplicate bursts. Update suggestion: exponential backoff with full jitter. defaults: base=50ms, cap=3000ms, max_retries=6.
shawn-devex: Can you paste short snippets? I'll slot them into the onboarding guide.
natalie-sdk: Node example (send header + env toggle):
```js
// enable safe replay for local dev
process.env.REDWOOD_SDK_SAFE_REPLAY = 'dev'
await fetch('/orders', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key': generateUUID() },
  body: JSON.stringify(order)
})
```
Go example (basic backoff helper):
```go
// backoff with full jitter
func Backoff(attempt int) time.Duration {
  base := 50 * time.Millisecond
  cap := 3 * time.Second
  max := float64(cap)
  sleep := math.Min(max, float64(base)*(math.Pow(2, float64(attempt))))
  return time.Duration(rand.Float64() * sleep) // full jitter
}
```
alex-ops: Nice. Also let's make the sampleapp tests assert no duplicate side effects after a 401+retry flow.
ci-bot: unit tests: go-sdk/backoff_test.go failed (coverage decreased) — see pipeline #4521.
natalie-sdk: I'll open a single PR that does: Node/Go/Python SDK opt-in safe-replay, sampleapp header change, update onboarding docs, and add backoff tests. Assigning reviewers: @shawn-devex @alex-ops.
maria-ux: Thanks — that'll eliminate the onboarding surprise for customers and keep server changes minimal. :thumbsup:
